ALTER PROC [DW].[SP_DW_FACTAVERAGEDAILYBALANCEMTD]  AS
BEGIN


INSERT INTO DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD
(
     BusinessDateSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFull
    ,AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm
)

SELECT 
BusinessDateSK AS BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK AS BranchSK
,BankSK AS BankSK
,AccountSK AS AccountSK
,AccountId AS AccountId
,SUM(BalanceAmountFull_Original) OVER (PARTITION BY AccountSK,MONTH,YEAR ORDER BY BusinessDateSK) AS AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFull_Original  --change to original not yet applied from source
,(SUM(BalanceAmountProrated_Original) OVER (PARTITION BY AccountSK,MONTH,YEAR ORDER BY BusinessDateSK))/DAY AS AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated_Original --change to original not yet applied from source
,A.Currency_Original AS Currency_Original --no enhancement yet
,'PHP' AS Currency_Target
,A.PesoConversionRate AS PesoConversionRate --no enhancement yet
,(SUM(BalanceAmountFull) OVER (PARTITION BY AccountSK,MONTH,YEAR ORDER BY BusinessDateSK))/DAY AS AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFulll  --[20230831 - Karl]
,(SUM(BalanceAmountProrated) OVER (PARTITION BY AccountSK,MONTH,YEAR ORDER BY BusinessDateSK))/DAY  AS AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated
,SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
--INTO DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD_addtl_20230901  --[20230831 - Karl]
--INTO DW.FACTAVERAGEDAILYBALANCEMTD_UT_20230915
FROM 
dw.factdepositsoutstandingbalance_ut_20230914 A -- no enchancement yet
LEFT JOIN DW.DIMDATE B ON B.DateSK = A.BusinessDateSK
--where BalanceAmountFull <> 0
--where accountid = 'e2ba6557533d6f127242f633c834230a'
--order by 1
---WHERE B.Year = 2023  --[20230831 - Karl]
WHERE B.Year = 2023 OR (B.Year = 2022 AND B.Month = 12)  --[20230831 - Karl]
--AND NOT EXISTS(
--    SELECT * FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD B
--    WHERE 
--    A.BusinessDateSK = b.[BusinessDateSK]
--    and A.AccountId = b.AccountId 
--)

END
GO
